messages:
Maria (Sales): heads up — ACME POC readout tomorrow 11:00am PT. need final numbers, gaps, and a short expansion recommendation by EOD. who can pull metrics and a 1-slide summary? :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Ben (Solutions): Ill take metrics. uploading results shortly. quick ask: use-case was doc-assist (500–2k token prompts) + embeddings for search, right?
Alex (AE): yes — primary ask: response quality for product-matching prompts, plus embedding recall for search fallback. also pricing + dedicated discount guidance.
Ben (Solutions): correct. summary here: https://rwd.internal/s3/acme-poc/results-174512 (link)

Maria (Sales): perfect. paste the key numbers in thread please so I can build the slide.
Ben (Solutions): final metrics (from dedicated pool, 4x A100 equiv):
- latency p50: 82ms, p95: 210ms (95th bumped during long sequences)
- throughput: 75 rps sustained under target batching policy
- avg tokens per request: 1,100 tokens
- avg cost per request (hosted pricing): $0.098/request (~$0.000089/token)
- generation quality (eval suite, n=1,200 prompts): pass rate 91.8% (ACME rubric), hallucination rate 1.3%
- embedding recall@10: 0.87 (k=10)
- KV cache hit rate: 27% (prefix reuse)
Gaps: context bleed on 6k prompts, occasional instr. following drops for very long conversational histories.
Alex (AE): nice. any reproducible failures / examples we can show in the readout?
Ben (Solutions): yep adding 3 exemplars to the slide deck (one false positive, two prompt edge cases). snippet:```
# failing prompt simplified
User: "Find the SKU for the blue widget with 3-year warranty"
Model: "SKU-12345"  <-- wrong, should be SKU-54321 (reason: ambiguous alias in docs)
```
Rachel (PM): can you also include the eval harness command so eng can re-run post-changes?
Ben (Solutions): sure:```
python run_eval.py --prompts acme_prompts.json --model redwood/serve-optimized:2025-06 --batch-size 8 --out acme_results.json
```
Kevin (Security): quick security check — were logs disabled and was PII scrubbed for ACME dataset?
Ben (Solutions): yes: logs disabled at ingress, PII redaction run with our scrubber v2, retention set to 30 days. we used customer KMS for keys in the private deployment.
Kevin (Security): need that in writing for their security SIG. can you attach the Data Handling appendix and the completed DPT (security questionnaire) before EOD?
Ben (Solutions): attaching: https://rwd.internal/s3/acme-poc/dpt-filled-174512.pdf
Alex (AE): pricing question: if they want to scale to 300 rps with dedicated, what's ballpark committed spend and discount?
Ben (Solutions): rough thumb: 300 rps sustained maps to ~4x current dedicated pool -> ~$90k/month hosted equivalent. with 6m reserved commit we can offer ~28% discount + 24/7 support add-on. will draft numbers for the proposal.
Maria (Sales): great. next steps for readout: 1) one-slide metrics + exemplars (Ben) 2) security appendix & questionnaire (Ben + Kevin) 3) short expansion proposal w/ pricing bands + timeline (Alex) 4) ask engineering for remediation ETA on the two highest-priority gaps (Rachel to own eng ask). deliverables by 5pm PT.
Rachel (PM): looping in eng — @deploy-bot can we get an ETA on the hallucination fix and context-bleed mitigation?
deploy-bot: scheduled job created: ACME_POC_ISSUES-174512 -> assigned to eng-runtime. ETA: 2025-06-10 (ticket: https://rwd.internal/issue/ACME-174512).
Ben (Solutions): from SE side, quick mitigation we can propose is: 1) shorter prompt templates + canonicalization, 2) apply conservative retrieval filter for embeddings, 3) enable prompt-level dose of rule-based fallback for SKU lookups. should buy time until model patch.
Alex (AE): sounds good. can we price the fallback + integration as part of the pilot? helps them jump to production sooner.
Maria (Sales): yes please include that option in the slide: pilot + remediation scope, and a recommended expansion ask (6m reserved at 300 rps).
Kevin (Security): I'll review the DPT PDF and confirm it's acceptable for their security SIG; ping me if Legal needs to countersign.
Ben (Solutions): uploaded slide draft here: https://rwd.internal/s3/acme-poc/readout-slide-draft-174512.pptx — comments welcome.
Maria (Sales): thanks team. I'll consolidate into final deck and present tomorrow. anything else?
Alex (AE): can someone add a short call-to-action for procurement (PO template + billing contact)?
Ben (Solutions): adding PO template link to slide notes.
Maria (Sales): perfect. closing this thread for now — please DM me if you miss the deadline. :thumbsup:
